title: Triund
summary: Up through the cloud forest above Dharamshala to the Triund ridge, under the snow peaks of the Dhauladhar.

trail-01.avif.caption: Into the cloud on the trail
trail-01.avif.alt: A hiker with a backpack stands on a rocky mountain trail, looking up into thick white cloud

half-point-01.avif.caption: Best View Half Point
half-point-01.avif.alt: A shaggy dog sits on a stone wall beside a Best View Half Point sign and prayer flags, cloud filling the valley below

market-mules-01.avif.caption: Pack mules in the market lane
market-mules-01.avif.alt: Pack mules loaded with gas cylinders stand in a busy market lane in hazy sunlight

ridge-cow-01.avif.caption: On the Triund ridge
ridge-cow-01.avif.alt: A brown cow walks along a grassy ridge in front of a bank of cloud, snowy peaks rising above it

cloud-forest-01.avif.caption: Cloud forest below the ridge
cloud-forest-01.avif.alt: Mist drifting over steep mountain slopes covered in dense green forest

night-sky-01.avif.caption: Night over Triund
night-sky-01.avif.alt: A dark night sky full of stars above a faint glow on the horizon

dhauladhar-01.avif.caption: The Dhauladhar above the cloud
dhauladhar-01.avif.alt: Snow-streaked rocky peaks rising out of a sea of cloud under a blue sky

dhauladhar-02.avif.caption: The Dhauladhar up close
dhauladhar-02.avif.alt: A steep granite peak with patches of snow against a clear blue sky
